gen-gf-baumans-gf-akatab: Akatab keeps its round letters cupped and approachable, never clenched. And Baumans, drawn with one constant stroke and no sparkle, gives that softness a sturdy, distinctive frame to sit under.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans lets the tails of its curves hang well back from the body, a modern sans-serif that Baumans leans on with its hairline-free strokes. Text in it moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-albert-sans: Baumans stamps its wide-open c like a crescent wrench, every stroke the same thickness. But Albert Sans below it keeps its apertures open at tiny sizes, so a long passage stays easy going.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alef: Baumans makes its stems and arches identical in thickness, with a c like a crescent wrench opened wide. And Alef follows with open-ended curves throughout, a modern sans that lets the heading's commanding look stay the star.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Alegreya Sans SC leaves a welcoming gap in its c, a contemporary sans-serif with modern manners. Yet Baumans is the sturdier voice, its s spine matching its terminals in thickness.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-almarai: Crisp, wrench-wide and bold in outline. Baumans leads with one unwavering line width, then Almarai, a sans-serif whose letters never pinch shut, carries a long passage along without any fuss.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-amarna: Blunt, distinctive letters with a c like a crescent wrench opened wide, all in Baumans. Shrink that heading and it would lose its swagger, while Amarna stays unclogged.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-andika: A c like a crescent wrench opened wide gives Baumans its signature look. And Andika backs it up with tails and terminals as thick as its stems, plus wide, easy turns in the s.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-anta: Anta reads approachable and professional, with gaping mouths on the e and a wire-bent sign look. Baumans handles the commanding statements, while Anta handles the steady running text beneath them.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-antic: That crescent-wrench c is pure Baumans, with every stroke drawn at one thickness and a commanding, distinctive air. And Antic takes over for the running text, its open letter mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined.
